text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Automatic page fired — service= inference-gateway • region= us-east1 • symptom=5xx error rate spike • current 5xx% = 12.3% (baseline 0.5%) • pagerduty_incident: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: P1 triggered: INC12345 — 5xx surge on inference-gateway (us-east1). Auto-escalation in 5m unless acknowledged.
Maya: acked — I'm on it. pinging SRE and infra. :eyes:
Ravi: any deploys in last 10m?
Jo: not that I'm aware of. CI shows a canary finished ~15m ago for model-routing tweak but rollout was kept at 0% (shouldn't affect prod).
Lina: checking infra metrics… KV cache evictions jumped ~30s ago, connection queueing on pool-3. Sending prometheus queries.
Samir: looking at ingress logs — seeing spike of 5xx with consistent backend 502s coming from inference-runtime-1/host: gpu-node-07. Possible OOM or connection saturation.
Ops-Dispatch: temporarily re-routing new sessions away from us-east1 to us-west1 for requests with region_hint != required. Will flip route flag in 60s. :gear:
Maya: good. also can we enable fallback-model-variant for traffic to reduce memory pressure?
Jo: ready to flip fallback if you confirm. Command I'll use:
```
./platform/route set --service=inference-gateway --region=us-east1 --fallback=true --dry-run=false
```
Ravi: I'm SSH-ing into gpu-node-07 to check dmesg, qcache, and container restarts.
Ravi: logs: ```
[ 12:34:56 ] container inference-runtime-1[pid:3421] killed by OOM killer
[ 12:34:57 ] restart backoff: 3s
[ 12:35:10 ] healthcheck failed: /health -> 502
```
Ravi: looks like OOMs — likely due to sudden KV preheat and large batch sizes in recent requests.
SRE-Oncall: can we scale up pool-3 by +2 nodes? that should relieve pressure.
Samir: autoscaler didn't kick due to CPU threshold misconfig (oversized mem pressure not on the metric). I'll trigger manual scale: `k8s-scale pool-3 2`
Lina: started the scale. new nodes provisioning. hope for quick join (should be ~90s).
PagerDuty: INC12345 updated: acknowledged by Maya. Escalation paused.
Maya: while nodes spin up, set model-routing to use quantized-variant to cut memory per worker. Jo, can you deploy quantized-variant pin?
Jo: prepping rollout for quantized-variant v2.1 -> plan: canary 10% then 100% if stable. Executing canary now.
incidents-bot: NOTE: customer-impact flag=partial: affecting <5% of requests, several enterprise customers reporting timeouts.
Ops-Dispatch: re-route applied. roughly 40% of new sessions now land in us-west1. Metrics noise falling. :white_check_mark:
Samir: after quantized canary started, instances show lower RSS and fewer OOM events in logs. Errors dropping to ~4% 5xx.
Maya: maintain routing and scaling for now. post-incident: need to adjust autoscaler to consider memory pressure metric and add circuit-breaker for large batch requests.
Ravi: collecting full logs for nodes 06-08 and saving to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC12345/ — sharing link shortly.
Jo: can we also roll back the canary change from 15m ago? it wasn't rolled out but might have touched config. I don't see config pushes though.
Lina: no config pushes in infra in last 20m. suspect client-side burst from a partner integration hitting us with larger batch sizes. Sending note to partner slack.
Ops-Dispatch: PD note: routing change and scale completed, error-rate trending down.
PagerDuty: INC12345 status: acknowledged -> resolved (monitoring). auto-close scheduled in 2h if no regression.
Maya: marking incident mitigated. will keep monitoring for 30m. please add any follow-ups here.
Samir: follow-up: add mem-pressure alert to autopager (threshold: node OOM frequency >1/5m) and add runbook step to fallback to quantized-variant automatically.
Jo: I'll open a PR for autoscaler change and a playbook doc update.
Maya: I'll draft customer impact summary for CS and set a postmortem meeting at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
incidents-bot: NOTE: handoff reminder — if this persists, next on-call rotation will be paged.
Lina: quick note: partner confirmed they replayed a backlog at 12:33 which matches the spike window. coordinating mitigation on their side too.
Maya: thanks all — great triage. closing thread for real-time coordination, keep comments for follow-ups. :pray:
